original: 俺の唯一の楽しみを取り上げないでくれ。

en.text: Don't take away the only fun I have.

original: 俺も気になるな。

en.text: I also want to know.

original: 俺はお前より数学の勉強頑張ってるもんね。

en.text: I study math harder than you do.

original: 俺は、昔のままだ。

en.text: I'm still the same person I used to be.

original: 俺が子供の時は、毎週日曜日には教会に行ってたよ。

en.text: I went to church every Sunday when I was a boy.

original: 俺の気が変わる前に、行け。

en.text: Go, before I change my mind.

original: 仕事は俺が見つけてやる。約束するよ。

en.text: I promise I'll find you a job.
I promise to find you work.

original: 俺は死なずに死後の世界が見たいんだ。

en.text: I wanna see the afterlife without dying.

original: 猿も木から落ちるって言うけど、俺はいつ落ちるんやろ。

en.text: They say even monkeys fall from trees. I wonder when I will.

original: お前が話してた女って、俺の姉貴。

en.text: The woman to whom you were talking is my older sister.

original: 今ね、俺、超忙しい人なの。

en.text: I'm a busy man right now.

original: 俺の彼女、俺より上なんだ。

en.text: My girlfriend is older than me.
My girlfriend is older than I am.

original: 「寝れない」「俺も」

en.text: "I can't sleep." "Me neither."

original: 俺は子供たちを動物園に連れて行ったんだ。

en.text: I took the kids to the zoo.

original: 意外に俺聞き上手なのよ、こう見えて。

en.text: I'm a surprisingly good listener, despite how I look.

original: あの子、俺の友達。

en.text: That girl is my friend.

original: 俺に物を投げるなよ。

en.text: Don't throw things at me.

original: 今日は俺の番だぜ。

en.text: It's my turn today.

original: 一番の友達は俺だろ？

en.text: I'm your best friend, right?
